description: Preregistered deterministic multi-start reliability extension of the existing anchor-free pure-PWE experiment. Only requested targets and initial geometries vary; no physics, optimizer, or acceptance threshold changes.
case_order: target-major Cartesian product, starts in listed order
target_selection: Four prescribed gap widths selected before any new physics evaluations, not copied from historical geometry responses.
starting_point_selection: Center and two opposite off-boundary starts in the existing normalized parameter box; no saved inverse solutions.
acceptance: Search must match the unchanged internal tolerance, and the unchanged candidate must pass both the existing M25 error tolerance and error-plus-cutoff-change guard. Record every attempt, including nonmatches.
checkpoint_reuse: Only identical checked evaluations computed within this new experiment; no historical response tables or candidate anchors.
scope: Exploratory sampled-path gap recovery from three deterministic starts, not a statistical population estimate, unique inverse, full-Brillouin-zone certificate, or proof of global feasibility.
